author: mark
text:
CI: pin tarpaulin 0.35.2 to stop silent denominator shrink

tarpaulin 0.35.4 silently drops inline `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` files
from the coverable denominator. taiki-e/install-action installed the
latest, so the runner was measuring ~18% fewer lines than local while
both reported "100% covered" — coverage living only inside an inline
tests.rs module would land on main without ever appearing in the runner
count. Pinned in workflow + tarpaulin.toml comment + Makefile preflight
that refuses to run on any other version.
